title: Minimum Number of Days to Eat N Oranges
summary: Given an integer n representing the number of oranges, determine the least number of days required to consume all oranges by eating one per day or, if divisible by 2 or 3, eating half or two-thirds of the oranges, respectively, each day.
statement: Given an integer n representing the number of oranges, determine the least number of days required to consume all oranges by eating one per day or, if divisible by 2 or 3, eating half or two-thirds of the oranges, respectively, each day.
constraints: Each day eat one orange, or when divisible by two eat n/2 oranges, or when divisible by three eat 2n/3 oranges.
Return the minimum days to reach zero.
hints: A divide-by-two route first spends n mod 2 one-orange days, then one division day; similarly for three.
After at most two one-orange days a division is available, so any longer sequence of singles cannot beat one of these two choices.

tests.explanation: Eat one to reach nine, then reduce by three twice and eat the final orange, totaling four days.
Reduce six to two by the divide-by-three action, then reduce to one and eat it, totaling three days.
